g.text: UML sequence - exact trade approval, reservation and native financial receipt
Current canonical actor and exact terms
Lock current person; validate cash / shares; retain full quote + digest
Immutable authorization, expiry and issuer approval URL
Confirm identity for these exact terms
Authorization code + PKCE, fresh login, nonce and exact subject
Person lock; replay original receipt or reject key/input mismatch
Validate fresh matching proof and one authorization / command
Reserve native cash or unreserved microshares
Balanced native journal + position event + fill + outbox + original command receipt (atomic)
FILLED + actual batch, units, price and cash
Retain OPEN order and original reservation
Recover owned open order or expire
Revalidate native authority, current price and exact original reservation
Cancellation releases only an OPEN order's original reservation.
A request-key replay returns its original financial effect.
Reusing the authorization under a new key is refused.
TST assets and prices are explicitly synthetic.
